summary: Graviton (ARM) CPU inference routing is implemented for pytorch and tensorflow. Changes: inference_graviton sections added to pytorch.json and tensorflow.json; GRAVITON_ALLOWED_TARGET_INSTANCE_FAMILY and GRAVITON_ALLOWED_FRAMEWORKS added to fw_utils.py; image_uris.py gets a private _resolve_image_scope helper called before config load, plus a -sagemaker suffix rule for the Graviton repo; conftest gets graviton_pytorch_version and graviton_tensorflow_version fixtures; expected_uris.py gets graviton_framework_uri; new test module test_graviton.py. Verification: test_graviton_pytorch and test_graviton_tensorflow pass, and the collectable image_uris suite passes against the repo src (663 passed). Not verified: test_retrieve.py and image_uris/jumpstart, because the shared venv lacks the mock package. Choices: Elastic Inference requests skip Graviton routing to avoid a misleading log; the suffix applies only to the Graviton repo. Known pre-existing issue, unchanged: a non-string instance type raises AttributeError in the existing _processor. Nothing committed. The venv's sagemaker editable install points at a shared base/src directory, so test runs use PYTHONPATH set to the repo src.
